senses.zh: be 的第一和第三人称单数过去式

ex.en: We climbed the hill before stopping for a picnic.
ex.zh: 我们爬上山坡，然后停下来野餐。

ex.en: As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本持续上涨，许多年轻人难以在大城市独立生活。

ex.en: The nearest bus stop is about a kilometre away.
ex.zh: 最近的公交车站大约在一公里外。

ex.en: Building safe cycle lanes within a kilometre of schools could encourage more children to cycle daily.
ex.zh: 在学校周边一公里内修建安全的自行车道，可以鼓励更多孩子每天骑车。

ex.en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
ex.zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。

ex.en: Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应向缺乏基本医疗服务的偏远社区派遣医疗队。

ex.en: The repair cost nearly a thousand dollars in total.
ex.zh: 维修费总共将近一千美元。

ex.en: Several thousand residents have benefited from the new cycle routes connecting suburban neighbourhoods with the city centre.
ex.zh: 连接郊区社区与市中心的新自行车道已让数千名居民受益。

ex.en: The children shaped wet clay into tiny bowls.
ex.zh: 孩子们把湿陶土捏成了小碗。

ex.en: Traditional clay buildings can provide effective insulation, helping communities maintain comfortable indoor temperatures with less energy.
ex.zh: 传统黏土建筑能有效隔热，帮助社区以更少的能源维持舒适的室内温度。

ex.en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
ex.zh: 我能看见树梢上方有一道彩虹。

ex.en: When students see how science applies to everyday life, they often become more interested in learning.
ex.zh: 当学生理解科学如何应用于日常生活时，他们往往会对学习更感兴趣。

ex.en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。

ex.en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 毛巾在阳光下晾过后已经干了。

ex.en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
ex.zh: 长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。

senses.zh: 做（某个动作；和名词连用代替某个动词）

ex.en: We roasted a pumpkin and served it with rice.
ex.zh: 我们烤了一个南瓜，配米饭一起吃。

ex.en: Growing crops such as pumpkin in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 在社区菜园种植南瓜等作物，可以让城市社区居民更容易获得新鲜食物。

ex.en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边找到了一家安静的餐馆。

ex.en: Local restaurants can attract tourists by serving traditional dishes made with ingredients from nearby farms.
ex.zh: 当地餐馆可以用附近农场的食材制作传统菜肴，以此吸引游客。

ex.en: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
ex.zh: 太阳还没升起，我们就到了机场。

ex.en: Expanding an airport may boost tourism, but it can also increase noise pollution for nearby residents.
ex.zh: 扩建机场可能促进旅游业，但也可能加重附近居民受到的噪声污染。

ex.en: She works as a guide at the local museum.
ex.zh: 她在当地博物馆担任讲解员。

ex.en: As public transport becomes more reliable, fewer commuters may choose to drive to work.
ex.zh: 随着公共交通变得更加可靠，选择开车上班的通勤者可能会减少。

ex.en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在桥上观看了划船比赛。

ex.en: Schools should ensure that all children receive equal educational opportunities, regardless of their race or family income.
ex.zh: 学校应确保所有儿童都享有平等的教育机会，不论其种族或家庭收入。

ex.en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
ex.zh: 今天早饭前，我们跑步穿过了公园。

ex.en: Local councils often run training programmes to help unemployed residents develop skills needed by employers.
ex.zh: 地方议会经常开办培训项目，帮助失业居民培养雇主所需的技能。

ex.en: We cheered as our neighbour crossed the finish line.
ex.zh: 邻居冲过终点线时，我们欢呼起来。

ex.en: When spectators cheer for every participant, community sporting events can foster a stronger sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 当观众为每位参与者喝彩时，社区体育活动能培养更强的归属感。

ex.en: The writer filled her notebook while waiting for the train.
ex.zh: 那位作家等火车时，把笔记本写得满满的。

ex.en: A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 优秀的作者能让读者理解复杂的环境问题，同时不过度简化科学证据。

ex.en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。

ex.en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
ex.zh: 经常阅读的儿童通常能培养更强的语言能力，对世界也有更广泛的了解。

ex.en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
ex.zh: 请在你出门上班前叫醒我。

ex.en: People who wake at consistent times may find it easier to maintain healthy sleep patterns.
ex.zh: 在固定时间醒来的人可能更容易保持健康的睡眠规律。

ex.en: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
ex.zh: 等我们吃完饭，我稍后再洗碗。

ex.en: Children who develop strong reading habits often achieve better academic results later in life.
ex.zh: 养成良好阅读习惯的孩子，往往在日后的学习中取得更好的成绩。

ex.en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
ex.zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授网络安全知识，让孩子养成负责任地使用互联网的习惯。

ex.en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们队还是赢得了比赛。

ex.en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。

senses.zh: （进行比较时用于加强语气）以往任何时候

ex.en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
ex.zh: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。

ex.en: Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.
ex.zh: 应鼓励生病的员工休息，而不是立即返岗。

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
ex.zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。

ex.en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

ex.en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
ex.zh: 晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。

ex.en: Unless cities improve public transport soon, traffic congestion is likely to become increasingly severe.
ex.zh: 除非城市尽快改善公共交通，否则交通拥堵很可能日益严重。

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
ex.zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。

ex.en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。

ex.en: The dusty room made me cough several times.
ex.zh: 房间里的灰尘让我咳嗽了好几次。

ex.en: People with a persistent cough should seek medical advice, particularly if symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities.
ex.zh: 持续咳嗽的人应就医咨询，尤其是在症状影响睡眠或日常活动时。

ex.en: Let's discuss our holiday plans over dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我们边吃晚饭边商量度假计划吧。

ex.en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
ex.zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。

ex.en: My usual diet includes plenty of rice and vegetables.
ex.zh: 我的日常饮食中有大量米饭和蔬菜。

ex.en: A balanced diet can improve concentration and help students maintain their energy throughout the school day.
ex.zh: 均衡饮食能提高注意力，并帮助学生在整个上学期间保持精力。

ex.en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
ex.zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。

ex.en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

ex.en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。

ex.en: Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 环保团体呼吁制定更严格的法规，减少流入河流和海洋的塑料垃圾。

ex.en: Please email me the photos from our camping trip.
ex.zh: 请把我们露营旅行的照片通过电子邮件发给我。

ex.en: Although email enables rapid communication, excessive messages can distract employees and reduce productivity at work.
ex.zh: 虽然电子邮件可以实现快速沟通，但过多的邮件会分散员工注意力，降低工作效率。

ex.en: He looked unhappy when the picnic was cancelled.
ex.zh: 野餐取消后，他显得很不开心。

ex.en: Residents are unhappy with the proposed road expansion because it would remove valuable green space.
ex.zh: 居民对拟议中的道路扩建不满意，因为它会占用宝贵的绿地。

ex.en: The ball hit the window and shattered the glass.
ex.zh: 球砸中了窗户，把玻璃打碎了。

ex.en: Recycling glass reduces demand for raw materials and can lower energy consumption in the manufacturing sector.
ex.zh: 回收玻璃能减少对原材料的需求，并可降低制造业的能源消耗。

ex.en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
ex.zh: 如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。

ex.en: Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 为城市社区增加绿地可以改善居民的身心健康，并为野生动物提供栖息地。

ex.en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段企鹅在冰上滑行的视频。

ex.en: Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.
ex.zh: 教学视频可以让复杂的过程更容易理解，对背景知识有限的学生尤其如此。

ex.en: The shop sells handmade goods from nearby villages.
ex.zh: 这家店出售附近村庄制作的手工商品。

ex.en: Transporting goods by rail rather than road can lower emissions and reduce congestion in urban areas.
ex.zh: 采用铁路而非公路运输货物可以降低排放，缓解城市拥堵。

ex.en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。

ex.en: Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.
ex.zh: 可靠的公交服务让没有汽车的居民也能到达医院、学校和工作地点。

ex.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。

ex.en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
ex.zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。

ex.en: We examined a drop of pond water under the microscope.
ex.zh: 我们用显微镜观察了一滴池塘水。

ex.en: Using a microscope allows students to observe cell structures that are invisible to the naked eye.
ex.zh: 使用显微镜能让学生观察到肉眼无法看见的细胞结构。

ex.en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
ex.zh: 我们很幸运，赶上了回家的末班公交车。

ex.en: Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.
ex.zh: 虽然一些创业者受益于偶然的机遇，但企业的长期成功通常需要周密规划和持续努力。

ex.en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
ex.zh: 我留了一半三明治，准备晚点吃。

ex.en: Nearly half of the residents surveyed supported creating more green spaces in the city centre.
ex.zh: 受访居民中近一半支持在市中心增设绿地。

ex.en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
ex.zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。

ex.en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。

ex.en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
ex.zh: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.
ex.zh: 小企业越来越多地在线销售产品，以吸引本地社区以外的顾客。

ex.en: She keeps homemade jam in a small glass jar.
ex.zh: 她把自制果酱装在一个小玻璃罐里。

ex.en: Reusing glass jars for food storage can help households reduce their reliance on disposable plastic packaging.
ex.zh: 重复使用玻璃罐储存食品可以帮助家庭减少对一次性塑料包装的依赖。

ex.en: We watched a bright planet through the telescope tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我们用望远镜观察了一颗明亮的行星。

ex.en: Scientists study distant planets to understand whether conditions suitable for life exist beyond Earth.
ex.zh: 科学家研究遥远的行星，以了解地球以外是否存在适合生命的条件。

ex.en: The children dug into the damp earth with small spades.
ex.zh: 孩子们用小铲子挖开湿润的泥土。

ex.en: Life on earth depends on healthy ecosystems that provide clean water, food, and breathable air.
ex.zh: 地球上的生命依赖于能够提供洁净水源、食物和可呼吸空气的健康生态系统。

ex.en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
ex.zh: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。

ex.en: The cat usually sleeps indoors during the daytime.
ex.zh: 这只猫白天通常在屋里睡觉。

ex.en: Higher daytime temperatures may force outdoor workers to adjust their schedules during the summer months.
ex.zh: 夏季白天气温升高，可能迫使户外工作者调整工作时间。

ex.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
ex.zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
ex.zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。

ex.en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。

ex.en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
ex.zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。

ex.en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。

ex.en: We watched the sun rise over the ocean.
ex.zh: 我们看着太阳从海面上升起。

ex.en: Plastic waste entering the ocean threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human health through food chains.
ex.zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生动物，并最终可能通过食物链影响人类健康。
